Compatibility | **Will you ever fix VortexPro versions prior to version <2.4 not working?** | If you mean the website URL, probably not any time soon as vortex changed its domain from towerstats.vortex to playvortex.io, but as for the CSS literally breaking because the UI of vortex has changed or been renamed, probably not any time soon, but you can attempt it yourself.
Compatibility | **Will you ever port VortexPro to FireFox?** | No. VortexPro will not be ported over to Firefox at least not right now. maybe in the far far future.

Finance | **Can I donate money to VortexPro?** | No. Support me instead by giving me feedback on your experience with using VortexPro.

# Accessibility Statement

Welcome! We are committed to ensuring our project is accessible, inclusive, and usable by everyone, regardless of technology or ability. We strive to follow the [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://w3.org) standards.

## Key Features & Conformance
Our project actively wants to add the following accessibility practices:
- **Keyboard Navigation:** All interactive elements are fully operable using a keyboard, with clear, visible focus states.
- **Screen Reader Support:** Semantic HTML and proper ARIA attributes are used to provide meaningful context to assistive technologies.
- **Visual Contrast:** Interface colors meet the minimum contrast ratios (e.g., 4.5:1 for normal text) to accommodate visual impairments.
- **Descriptive Media:** Images include descriptive alternative (ALT) text, and videos include captions or transcripts where applicable.

## Reporting Barriers & Feedback
If you encounter any accessibility barriers, missing alt text, or keyboard traps, please let us know.
Please open an issue in our repository and apply the `accessibility` or `a11y` label. To help us resolve the issue quickly, please include:
1. What you were trying to do and what went wrong.
2. The exact page or URL where the barrier occurred.
3. Your device, operating system, and assistive technology (e.g., screen reader version).

# Localization

To translate the Vortex Platform into different languages, I recommend you use the 'translate' feature built-in the Microsoft Edge or Chrome Web Browser.

## Need Help?
If you have questions about using VortexPro, run into issues, or need to clarify a concept, please start by doing the following:
1. **Check the Documentation:** Review the `README.md` and VortexPro's [Documentation](insert-docs-link-here) to see if your question is already answered.
2. **Search Existing Issues:** Check the VortexPro [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Klingri/VortexPro/issues) page to see if someone else has already asked or solved your problem.
3. **Talk to a Duck:** Try to define exactly what you are trying to do, what problem you are encountering, and what steps you've taken so far. 

## Reporting Bugs
If you have found a bug in VortexPro, please help us fix it quickly by [opening a Bug Report](https://github.com/Klingri/VortexPro/issues). 
* Please provide sample code, screenshots, or error logs if possible.
* Clearly outline the steps required to reproduce the issue.

## Suggesting Enhancements
If you have an idea or feature request, please [submit a Feature Request](https://github.com/Klingri/VortexPro/issues) and tell us how this enhancement would benefit VortexPro.

## How You Can Support the Project
If you love using VortexPro, There are several ways you can show your support and help the VortexPro community grow:
* **Star the Repository:** Click the ⭐ "Star" button at the top of the VortexPro repository page.
* **Share the Project:** Mention VortexPro in group chats, comment sections, on social media, or tell your friends about it!
* **Add a Backlink:** If you are using this in your own project, link back to this repository in your `README.md`. 

Thank you for your support!
